entries.desc_en: Xiaohongshu CLI built for agents: search notes, read content, analyze creators and publish image posts, authenticated with browser cookies.

entries.name: x-mcp
entries.desc: xiaohongshu-mcp 的浏览器插件版：装插件即用，不用部署 Docker 或 Python，在你常用的浏览器里发小红书
entries.desc_en: Browser-extension edition of xiaohongshu-mcp: no Docker or Python, publishes to Xiaohongshu from your everyday browser.

entries.name: catbus
entries.desc: 一个命令操作小红书、抖音、TikTok、B站、快手、微博、X 等：搜索、评论、下载、发布、私信、直播弹幕，统一 JSON 输出
entries.desc_en: One CLI for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, Bilibili, Kuaishou, Weibo, X and more: search, comments, downloads, posting, DMs and live comments, with unified JSON output.

entries.name: xint
entries.desc: 本地优先的 X 数据命令行：搜索、监控、分析、导出、OAuth 操作，用你的 X API
entries.desc_en: Local-first X intelligence CLI for search, monitoring, analysis, exports and OAuth actions on your own X API access.

entries.name: zhihu-cli
entries.desc: 知乎命令行：搜索、热榜、看问题和回答、发想法、提问和文章，扫码或 Cookie 登录，附 skill
entries.desc_en: Zhihu CLI: search, hot list, questions and answers, and posting thoughts, questions and articles, with QR or cookie login and an agent skill.

entries.name: weibo-cli
entries.desc: 微博命令行：热搜、关键词搜索、时间线、评论转发、用户主页，附 skill
entries.desc_en: Weibo CLI: hot search, keyword search, timelines, comments, reposts and user profiles from the terminal, with an agent skill.

entries.name: dy-cli
entries.desc: 抖音命令行 dy-cli：搜索、下载、发布、互动、热榜、直播和数据分析，输出适合 agent 读
entries.desc_en: dy-cli, a Douyin CLI for agents: search, download, publish, engage, hot lists, livestreams and analytics, with agent-friendly output.

entries.name: postiz-app
entries.desc: 开源社媒排程平台：排期、自动化和数据分析，可用云版或自己部署，支持 agent 接入
entries.desc_en: Open-source social media scheduling, automation and analytics; use Postiz Cloud or self-host, with agent integrations.

entries.name: OpenCreator
entries.desc: 原 KrillinAI：创作者 AI 工作台，视频下载、翻译配音、做视频图片和语音、剪辑，内置 Codex agent
entries.desc_en: Formerly KrillinAI: an open-source creator workspace for video download, translation and dubbing, making video, images and voice, and editing, powered by Codex.

entries.name: xiaobei
entries.desc: 小贝：给小微企业的自媒体获客智能体（基于 OpenClaw），公众号写作推送、小红书图文、视频分发、评论区获客、数据复盘
entries.desc_en: Xiaobei: a social-media lead-generation agent for small businesses, built on OpenClaw — WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu posts, video distribution, comment-section leads and analytics reviews.

entries.name: we-mp-rss
entries.desc: WeRSS：公众号订阅助手，定时抓新文章生成 RSS，转 Markdown/PDF，支持 Webhook 和 API 给 agent 用
entries.desc_en: WeRSS: subscribe to WeChat Official Accounts, fetch new articles on a schedule as RSS, convert to Markdown or PDF, with webhooks and an API for agents.

entries.name: Easel
entries.desc: Easel：ZJU-REAL 开源的社媒 agent，在小红书、抖音、知乎、B 站等平台找趋势、策划、创作、发布和复盘，记住你的账号画像
entries.desc_en: Easel: an open-source social media agent from ZJU-REAL that discovers trends, plans, creates, publishes and reviews across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Zhihu, Bilibili and more, remembering your account profile.

entries.name: social-media-agent
entries.desc: LangChain 的社媒 agent：读一个链接生成 X 和 LinkedIn 帖子，人工确认后排期发布
entries.desc_en: LangChain's social media agent: turns a URL into X and LinkedIn posts, with human-in-the-loop review before scheduling.

entries.name: chatwiki
entries.desc: ChatWiki：公众号 AI 知识库和客服工作流平台，拖拽搭建自动回复等应用
entries.desc_en: ChatWiki: an AI knowledge-base and customer-service workflow platform for the WeChat ecosystem, with drag-and-drop automations such as auto-replies.

entries.name: Beav
entries.desc: Beav（原 RedBox）：小红书 AI 运营工作台，采集笔记和评论、素材库、选题、写作和配图，本地桌面应用
entries.desc_en: Beav (formerly RedBox): a local desktop AI workspace for Xiaohongshu — collect notes and comments, build a material library, plan topics, write and lay out images.

entries.name: locoagent
entries.desc: 用真实浏览器自动运营社媒的 agent：X、LinkedIn、Reddit 的浏览、互动和发帖
entries.desc_en: An AI agent that operates social media through a real browser: browsing, engagement and posting on X, LinkedIn and Reddit.
